citations.revision_finding: Figure 14's step 5(a) carries the same footnote as F_SM's step 4(c): the provision was MISSING from reference [25], this paper's own CRYPTO 2022 proceedings version. Transcribed as line 51. Both functionalities in the decomposition were corrected the same way after publication.
citations.ambiguity_finding: Step 6(b) of Figure 14 writes receive_attempts[epoch num] with a bare epoch_num, where every other use of the variable in the figure is subscripted by a party and the two parties' numbers differ. Read as the receiver's own en[i] (line 55), because it is the receiver's call. The alternative reading changes which bucket the corruption interface reports at line 65.
citations.unprinted_operation_finding: Step 2 of Figure 14 guards on 'if sending_chain_key_{1-i} has been deleted', and the functionality prints no deletion anywhere. Read as never-set (line 45), the only reading its own code supports.
